entities.summary:
Armani/Silos is a fashion art museum in Milan, Italy dedicated to the Armani style founded by Giorgio Armani. The opening exhibition was divided into themes:Ground floor: "Heimat: A Sense of Belonging", the dedicated to Peter Lindbergh 
First floor: Androgynous
Second floor: Ethnicities
Third floor: Stars / Digital Archive. Armani/Silos is a real property in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
